# Prusa CORE One+ | Original Prusa 3D printers directly from Josef Prusa

Prusa CORE One marked a significant leap forward in the CoreXY market, with
[TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/pro/original-prusa-core-one-3d-printer-review)
calling it “by far the most advanced and functional printer of this type on the market
at present.” Recognized for its excellent build and professional-grade features, it
delivers consistently reliable performance with top speed, accuracy, and versatility –
earning it the title of “Best Enclosed 3D Printer of 2025” by
[All3DP](https://all3dp.com/1/best-3d-printer-reviews-top-3d-printers-home-3-d-printer-3d/#enclosed-prusa-core-one).
With a Red Dot Award to its name, it also proves that functionality can go hand-in-hand
with standout design.

## Seamless Workflow

### Everything you need under one roof

When you buy the Prusa CORE One+, you’re getting **a full experience** – a huge free 3D
model library, an easy to use software, remote management, native mobile app, premium
quality materials… everything is ready for your convenience!

![Printables.com](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/printables-large.jpg)
![Printables.com](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/printables-large.jpg)

### Printables.com

You don’t have to be a designer to use a 3D printer! Our database of hundreds of
thousands of free 3D models is just a click away.
[Printables.com](https://www.printables.com/) is **actively developed and
ever-growing,** so go ahead and **get amazing prints by talented creators and even
official printable accessories** for a variety of popular products thanks to Printables
Brands. You can send models from [Printables.com](https://www.printables.com/) to
PrusaSlicer in a single click!

![EasyPrint](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/easyprint_eshop_640x360_01.jpg)
![EasyPrint](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/easyprint_eshop_640x360_01.jpg)

### EasyPrint

Slice from anywhere on your phone, tablet, or in the browser! Prusa EasyPrint is an
innovative web-based tool that makes slicing 3D models seamless for everyone. With
EasyPrint, you can adjust all key print settings in seconds. Send sliced models directly
to your Prusa printer in just a few clicks from Printables or the Prusa mobile app.

![PrusaSlicer](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/prusaslicer-large.jpg)
![PrusaSlicer](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/prusaslicer-large.jpg)

### PrusaSlicer

The best slicer out there! An **open-source, feature-rich, frequently updated tool**
that contains everything you need to export the perfect print files for your 3D printer.
All official printer and material profiles (over 200 in total) are **created and tested
in-house** to ensure the best possible printing experience! And **you don’t have to be a
pro to use it,** the default profiles let you slice most models with one click.
PrusaSlicer is based on Slic3r by Alessandro Ranellucci.

![Prusa Connect](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/Prusa_connect.jpg)
![Prusa Connect](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/Prusa_connect.jpg)

### Prusa Connect

Our internally-developed **highly secure remote print management software** is here to
make your printing experience a breeze. It’s **fully integrated with PrusaSlicer** and
enables you to quickly send your print files to the CORE One, schedule tasks, and
monitor your machine remotely. It’s an incredibly powerful tool with new features being
added all the time.

![Prusa App](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/coreoneapp.jpg)
![Prusa App](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/coreoneapp.jpg)

### Prusa App

The new streamlined Prusa App gives you a complete overview of your printer no matter
where you are. With no ads, points or other bloatware, the app is easy to navigate and
use. The app also has full Printables integration, so you can **send ready-made G-codes
directly into your printer** without the need to slice them!

![Prusament](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/prusament-large.jpg)
![Prusament](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/prusament-large.jpg)

### Prusament

We were not satisfied with the quality of filaments on the market, so we started
manufacturing our own! Prusament offers top-class manufacturing precision, **perfect
color consistency** and a wide range of materials from PLA to PCCF. **Every Prusament
material has an in-house tested profile** in PrusaSlicer.

## Create colorful 3D objects!

### Ready for the MMU3

The CORE One+ is compatible with the MMU3, the add-on for the fastest single-nozzle
printing with up to five filaments at the same time. You can create beautiful, colorful
objects, and you won’t have to throw half of your filaments away or constantly clean the
surroundings of your printer. **Our solution uses an innovative retraction technique and
a compact wipe tower to manage filament changes.** This not only **reduces the wasted
filament** but also deposits all the waste to a single, tidy block. MMU3 for the Prusa
Core ONE is now available!
[Explore all the possible upgrade paths.](https://www.prusa3d.com/category/core-one-mmu3/)

## Make it your own!

### Designed for modders

No parts of the printer are glued together, **everything can be taken apart with a set
of screwdrivers** and there’s plenty of room for mods, creativity and customization – so
go ahead and make the CORE One+ your own! Print magnetic holders, organizers, or just
plain fun stuff to make your printer stand out.

Our software and firmware are **open-source and you can grab the source codes at
[GitHub.com.](https://github.com/prusa3d)** This allows you to modify the code, come up
with your own improvements and tweaks. **We often cooperate with our community members
on new features,** and you can become one of them! Or if you don’t want to dig into the
code, you can try your hand at modifying the printed parts of the printer. There are
dozens of opportunities for all sorts of projects!

### Expand it with accessories!

You can expand the CORE One+ with useful accessories. We offer an **optional USB-C
camera,** and you can calibrate the Input Shaper profiles on modded printers with an
optional accelerometer. Or play with the **GPIO hackerboard,** an accessory for
enthusiasts that enables you to **control external devices with G-Code commands.** We're
also preparing two different types of filtration, a drybox, and more - stay tuned!

![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/addons/camera/core-one-cam-4ku3.jpg)
![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/addons/camera/core-one-cam-4ku3.jpg)

You can install an **optional high-resolution camera add-on** into the CORE One+'s
chamber for remote print monitoring. The camera connects using a USB-C cable directly
into the motherboard and it requires an active Wi-Fi connection to function.
[Find more about the chamber camera for the Prusa CORE One+.](https://www.prusa3d.com/product/buddy3d-camera-for-prusa-core-one/)

![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/6_GPIO.jpg)
![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/6_GPIO.jpg)

The GPIO module is an optional add-on for advanced users (basic programming / soldering
skills required). It extends functionality of the printer by allowing you to control and
receive **input from external devices using GPIO pins and G-code commands,** so you can,
e.g., control LEDs or remote **triggers for DSLR cameras.**
[Find more about the GPIO Hackerboard.](https://www.prusa3d.com/product/gpio-hackerboard-set/)

![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/7_AdvancedFiltrationSystem.jpg)
![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=640,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/7_AdvancedFiltrationSystem.jpg)

Studies have shown that most of the commonly used 3D printing materials should be safe,
but we wanted to take this a step further. The optional Advanced Filtration System is
useful when you print materials such as ASA and other **materials that produce an
increased number of ultra-fine particles and fumes during printing.** Fewer particles
and less odor in the air are always
better. [Find more about the Advanced Filtration System for the Prusa CORE One+.](https://www.prusa3d.com/product/advanced-filtration-for-prusa-core-one/)

## Ready for the Future

### With Exceptional Backwards Compatibility

When you buy the CORE One+, you’re investing into a **platform that will continue to
grow over time,** rather than something that you’ll have to replace in a year or two.
Prusa printers are well known for their exceptional reliability, durability and long
life cycle. We offer **excellent post-launch support** with regular firmware and even
hardware updates to expand your printer’s capabilities even years after launch. And when
a new machine comes out, we publish an upgrade kit.

When new tech comes out, it’s usually exciting but it can also be a little inconvenient
due to changes. You may need a new charger or a different phone case because the camera
has moved. Not so with the CORE One! **If you already own the MK4/S, you can reuse many
accessories, such as print sheets, nozzles, and hotends.** The CORE One uses many proven
MK4S parts, which is why we also offer a
[convenient conversion kit](https://www.prusa3d.com/product/mk4s-to-prusa-core-one-conversion-kit/).

![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=1300,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/2_ReadyfortheFuture.jpg)
![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=1300,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/2_ReadyfortheFuture.jpg)

## Optimized for print farms

### Boost your production with Prusa CORE One+

We run a massive print farm with **over 600 of our 3D printers** producing parts for new
3D printers, so we know what it takes to run such a massive operation. We designed the
Prusa CORE One+ so it fits right in – compact dimensions, **doors that open in full
180°**, possibility to feed the filament from a spool hanging above the printer, simple
maintenance, maximum reliability, easy printing of advanced materials… it’s the perfect
machine **for mass production**!

![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=1200,format=auto,quality=30,blur=50/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/3_Optimizedforprintfarms.jpg)
![](https://www.prusa3d.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=1200,format=auto,quality=85/content/wysiwyg/fotky/C1/3_Optimizedforprintfarms.jpg)

**100% Privacy: Offline Mode without Compromise**

You don’t have to connect the CORE One+ to the network - not even once, and you can
still enjoy the full experience without any drawbacks. The printer can be configured and
operated offline, including slicing and installation of firmware updates. The Wi-Fi
module can be easily unplugged for environments with the highest level of security.

We believe that no matter whether you’re developing a new-generation space shuttle, or
just printing toys for your kids, no organization should be interested in gathering
information about your prints or your printer’s surroundings. This is why our printers
can be found in top companies, universities and research institutions around the world.
See where our printers are used.

### Basic package includes:

**Warranty note**

Consumable parts, such as print sheets (smooth, textured, etc.), are not covered by the
warranty since their coatings are expected to deteriorate over time, unless the failure
is due to a defect in materials or workmanship. Cosmetic damage, which includes, but is
not limited to, scratches, dents, cracks, or other aesthetic damage, is also not
covered. Only sheets defective upon delivery are covered by the warranty.
